questions.question: Your version of a regular Tuesday morning:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Three steps into the day before most people are awake.

answers.label: B
answers.text: Slow. The world can wait until you're ready for it.

answers.label: C
answers.text: You have a rhythm. You follow it. It works.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Already carrying something. The day starts with weight.

questions.question: The part of the day you actually look forward to:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Mornings. Before anyone else is up. Momentum starts there.

answers.label: B
answers.text: The hour before bed. Everything done. Nothing left to do.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Whenever everyone leaves and the house goes quiet.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Late night. When the pressure drops and you can finally think.

questions.question: Your version of a perfect trip:

answers.label: A
answers.text: A city that demands your attention. Stakes and all.

answers.label: B
answers.text: One place, completely unhurried. You want to know it slowly.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Somewhere remote. No itinerary. Just disappear.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Move every two days. New places, full schedule.

questions.question: Your ideal way to start the morning:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Lie in bed until your body decides you're done.

answers.label: B
answers.text: One quiet ritual — coffee, journal, something that's just yours.

answers.label: C
answers.text: Intense workout or run before anything else.

answers.label: D
answers.text: Scroll through everything you missed overnight.

questions.question: What a good day actually feels like:

answers.label: A
answers.text: Nobody needed anything from you. That's the whole thing.

answers.label: B
answers.text: You moved through a lot. Things happened. You were in it.

answers.label: C
answers.text: You held it together under pressure. That counts.

answers.label: D
answers.text: You did exactly what mattered. Nothing more.
